title: Config / packs / team (docs/profile.md Layers and precedence, Team files; docs/packs.md Version pin)

steps.name: layers
steps.run: cd {state_dir}/a01 && python3 {source}/scripts/crew-config.py resolve --project crew.toml --org-profile org/profile.toml > layers.txt; rc=$?; grep -E '# (org|project|pack:github)$|^repo.default_branch' layers.txt | head -12; test $rc -eq 0 && grep -qxF 'repo.default_branch = "main"  # default' layers.txt && grep -qxF 'runtime.name = "tmux"  # org' layers.txt && grep -qxF 'runtime.options.builders = 2  # project' layers.txt && grep -qxF 'engines.default.order = ["claude-code/sonnet"]  # project' layers.txt && grep -qxF 'size_budget.builder = 16384  # core' layers.txt && grep -qxF 'backends.review.capabilities.post-verdict = "supported"  # pack:github' layers.txt

steps.name: team-two-repos
steps.run: cd {state_dir}/a01 && python3 {source}/scripts/crew-config.py resolve --project teams/campaign.toml > team.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat team.txt; test $rc -eq 1 && grep -q 'lists 2 repos; select one' team.txt && for r in alpha beta; do python3 {source}/scripts/crew-config.py resolve --project "teams/campaign.toml#$r" > $r.txt || exit 1; done; grep -E '# (team|repo)$' alpha.txt beta.txt; grep -qxF 'repo.name = "alpha"  # repo' alpha.txt && grep -qxF 'runtime.options.train_window = 120  # repo' alpha.txt && grep -qxF 'identities.reviewer.gh_user = "sandbox-reviewer"  # team' alpha.txt && grep -qxF 'paths.state_dir = "/campaign-a01/state/campaign"  # team' alpha.txt && grep -qxF 'repo.default_branch = "trunk"  # repo' beta.txt && grep -qxF 'runtime.options.train_window = 600  # core' beta.txt && grep -qxF 'sensitive.paths = ["billing/**"]  # repo' beta.txt && grep -qxF 'identities.builder.gh_user = "sandbox-builder"  # team' beta.txt

steps.name: team-render-separate
steps.run: cd {state_dir}/a01 && for r in alpha beta; do python3 {source}/scripts/crew-render.py --project "teams/campaign.toml#$r" --out out-$r || exit 1; done; grep -rho '/campaign-a01/state/campaign/campaign__[a-z]*/status/' out-alpha out-beta; grep -q 'campaign__alpha' out-alpha/runtime/builder.md && grep -q 'campaign__beta' out-beta/runtime/builder.md && ! grep -rq 'campaign/beta\|campaign__beta' out-alpha && ! grep -rq 'campaign/alpha\|campaign__alpha' out-beta

steps.name: bad-capability
steps.run: cd {state_dir}/a01 && python3 {source}/scripts/crew-config.py resolve --project bad-cap.toml --org-profile org/profile.toml > o.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; python3 {source}/scripts/crew-render.py --project bad-cap.toml --org-profile org/profile.toml --out out-bad >> o.txt 2>&1; rr=$?; cat o.txt; test $rc -eq 1 && test $rr -eq 1 && grep -q 'bad-cap.toml:backends.review.capabilities.post-verdict: expected supported' o.txt && test ! -e out-bad

steps.name: floor-lowering
steps.run: cd {state_dir}/a01 && python3 {source}/scripts/crew-config.py resolve --project bad-floor.toml --org-profile org/profile.toml > o.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat o.txt; test $rc -eq 1 && grep -q 'flavor.custom.lax.caps\[1\]: floor F1' o.txt && grep -q 'flavor.custom.lax.ci_waiver: floor F1' o.txt

steps.name: fix-and-rerun
steps.run: cd {state_dir}/a01 && sed -i.orig 's/post-verdict = "maybe"/post-verdict = "supported"/' bad-cap.toml && python3 {source}/scripts/crew-config.py resolve --project bad-cap.toml --org-profile org/profile.toml > o.txt && python3 {source}/scripts/crew-render.py --project bad-cap.toml --org-profile org/profile.toml --out out-fixed && tail -1 o.txt && grep -qxF 'backends.review.capabilities.post-verdict = "supported"  # project' o.txt && test -f out-fixed/runtime/builder.md

steps.name: external-pin-required
steps.run: cd {state_dir}/a01 && sed 's/^name = "github"/name = "campaign-forge"/' pack/manifest.toml > ext.toml && python3 {source}/scripts/crew-config.py validate ext.toml > o.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat o.txt; test $rc -eq 1 && grep -q 'pack.eng_crew_version: required for an external backend' o.txt

steps.name: bundle
steps.run:
cd {state_dir}/a01 && mkdir bundle bin st && git -C {source} archive HEAD | tar -x -C bundle && echo v9.9.9 > bundle/VERSION && printf '#!/bin/sh
echo "fake gh: $*" >&2
exit 1
' > bin/gh && chmod +x bin/gh && printf '[repo]
owner = "campaign"
name = "boot"
[flavor]
name = "standard"
[paths]
state_dir = "%s/st"
worktree_root = "%s/st/wt"
live_dir = "%s/st/live"
eng_crew = "%s/st/campaign__boot/eng-crew"
toolchain_bin = "/usr/bin"
' "$PWD" "$PWD" "$PWD" "$PWD" > boot.toml && cat bundle/VERSION

steps.name: bootstrap-bad-pin
steps.run:
cd {state_dir}/a01 && sed '/^name = "github"/a\
eng_crew_version = "not-a-release"
' pack/manifest.toml > m && mv m pack/manifest.toml && PATH="$PWD/bin:$PATH" python3 bundle/scripts/crew bootstrap --dry-run --project boot.toml --org-profile pack/profile.toml > o.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat o.txt; test $rc -eq 1 && grep -q 'pack.eng_crew_version must equal the stable installed tag v9.9.9' o.txt && test -z "$(ls -A st)"

steps.name: bootstrap-valid-pin
steps.run: cd {state_dir}/a01 && sed -i.bad 's/^eng_crew_version = .*/eng_crew_version = "v9.9.9"/' pack/manifest.toml && PATH="$PWD/bin:$PATH" python3 bundle/scripts/crew bootstrap --dry-run --project boot.toml --org-profile pack/profile.toml > o.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; echo "bootstrap exit $rc"; head -3 o.txt; ! grep -q eng_crew_version o.txt && grep -q '^ok    python' o.txt && test -z "$(ls -A st)"
